'''Garth McLaren''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 1st at [[May 2000 Williston Park tournament]] on 20 May 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|COTVG w/o Feeding]], according to Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d862">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-09-williston-park-ny-5-20-00-buck-beats-med862/ williston-park-ny-5-20-00-buck-beats-me], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 9 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-09-williston-park-ny-5-20-00-buck-beats-med862/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
